scriptLines: gender = iif(     lower(trim(gender)) == 'm' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'male',     'M',     iif(         lower(trim(gender)) == 'f' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'female',         'F',         gender     ) ),

date_of_birth = iif(     regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),     toDate(         concat(             iif(toInteger(right(trim(date_of_birth), 2)) <= 26, '20', '19'),             right(trim(date_of_birth), 2),             '-',             left(trim(date_of_birth), 2),             '-',             substring(trim(date_of_birth), 4, 2)         ),         'yyyy-MM-dd'     ),     coalesce(         toDate(date_of_birth, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),         toDate(date_of_birth, 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),         toDate(date_of_birth, 'MMM dd, yyyy'),         toDate(date_of_birth, 'MM-dd-yyyy'),         toDate(date_of_birth, 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),         toDate(date_of_birth, 'MM/dd/yyyy')     ) ),

admission_date =  iif(     regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),     toDate(         concat(             '20',             right(trim(admission_date), 2),             '-',             left(trim(admission_date), 2),             '-',             substring(trim(admission_date), 4, 2)         ),         'yyyy-MM-dd'     ),     coalesce(         toDate(admission_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),         toDate(admission_date, 'MM/dd/yyyy'),         toDate(admission_date, 'MM-dd-yyyy'),         toDate(admission_date, 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),         toDate(admission_date, 'MMMM dd, yyyy')     ) ),

discharge_date =  iif(     regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),     toDate(         concat(             '20',             right(trim(discharge_date), 2),             '-',             left(trim(discharge_date), 2),             '-',             substring(trim(discharge_date), 4, 2)         ),         'yyyy-MM-dd'     ),     coalesce(         toDate(discharge_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),         toDate(discharge_date, 'MM/dd/yyyy'),         toDate(discharge_date, 'MM-dd-yyyy'),         toDate(discharge_date, 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),         toDate(discharge_date, 'MMMM dd, yyyy')     ) ),

amount = toDecimal(     replace(         replace(             replace(                 replace(trim(amount), 'USD', ''),                 '$', ''             ),             ',', ''         ),         ' ', ''     ),     18,     2 ),

{payment_date¿} = iif(     isNull(payment_date),     toDate(null()),     iif(         regexMatch(payment_date, '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(payment_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),         iif(             regexMatch(payment_date, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'),             toDate(payment_date, 'MM/dd/yyyy'),             iif(                 regexMatch(payment_date, '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),                 toDate(payment_date, 'MM-dd-yy'),                 iif(                     regexMatch(payment_date, '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'),                     toDate(payment_date, 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),                     toDate(payment_date, 'MMMM dd, yyyy')                 )             )         )     ) )) ~> LimpiarBilling

query: 'SELECT admission_date AS fecha
FROM silver.admissions
WHERE admission_date IS NOT NULL

UNION

SELECT discharge_date AS fecha
FROM silver.admissions
WHERE discharge_date IS NOT NULL

UNION
SELECT payment_date AS fecha
FROM silver.billing
WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL',

ConvertirFechaNacimiento derive(edad = year(currentDate()) - year(date_of_birth) - iif(month(currentDate()) * 100 + dayOfMonth(currentDate()) < month(date_of_birth) * 100 + dayOfMonth(date_of_birth), 1, 0)) ~> DerivarEdad
rango_etario = case(isNull(edad), toString(null()), edad <= 18, '0-18', edad <= 35, '19-35', edad <= 60, '36-60', '60+'),
proveedor_seguro = iif(isNull(insurance_provider), 'Sin seguro', iif(trim(insurance_provider) == '', 'Sin seguro', trim(insurance_provider)))) ~> CrearColumnasDimPaciente
